## Named commit

Walkthrough · source:commit · Scope: `agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src`

Bound version: commit `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`; the full commit ID keeps this explanation tied to one version. I will explain the selected files from that commit and will not replace it with a branch tip.

## Named pull request

Walkthrough · source:pr · Scope: `agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src`

For a pull request, bind the pull-request number and the current base and head refs and IDs, for example `PR #42`, base `main` at `aaaaaaaa`, head `feature/login` at `bbbbbbbb`. Recheck those identities before each step. If the base or head changes, rebuild the map.

The source identities are separate: the commit uses one full commit ID; the pull request uses its current base and head.
